en: Black‑and‑white (with red overprint) postcard showing a street‑front view of multi‑storey town buildings housing the furniture factory and workshop of Otto Birkner Jr. The façades are brick and stucco with decorative window frames and signage. The left building bears painted signs for the Möbel­fabrik Otto Birkner jun. and a shop for baskets and baby carriages, while the right corner building has more ornate architecture and signage for the furniture factory and craft workshops. Printed red text at the top left gives the business name and address in Meissen, and a small red number appears at the bottom right.
